# Componenti di terze parti nel prototipo

| Componente | Origine | Licenza |
|---|---|---|
| `hanzi-writer.min.js` | [Hanzi Writer](https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer) v3.7.2 | MIT — vedi `LICENSE-hanzi-writer.txt` |
| `hanzi/*.json` (tratti dei 246 caratteri HSK 1) | [hanzi-writer-data](https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data) v2.0.1, derivati da [Make Me a Hanzi](https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi) e dai font di Arphic Technology | Arphic Public License — vedi `hanzi/ARPHICPL.TXT` |
